facts.fact: Somalia and the International Development Association signed Grant E179 (SDR 59.5 million) on 21 June 2023, financing construction of cross-border terrestrial links and backbone in Somalia and Somaliland as part of the Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project alongside South Sudan, the EAC and IGAD, closing 31 May 2028.
facts.system: Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project (EARDIP)
